prose: CM-H is an easy saber choreography for duelists to develop continuous flow. As a 6-hit combination, it crosses the body in a zig-zag motion allowing a lot of improve to be associated with this sequence. CM-H is worth 1 points in LUMINA. To learn its notation and more about the SaberCraft system, please visit SaberCraft.org
